result.summary: Found 4 issues, mostly layout-related involving content being cut off at the screen edge and category filter items being truncated.

issues.description: 'Trattoria Piccola' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, truncating both the image and text.
issues.suggestion: Implement proper horizontal scroll snapping or add partial card preview indication to show more content is available, or adjust card width to fit properly.

issues.description: Category filter pills ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') are cut off at the right edge, with an additional category partially visible/hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual scroll indicator (fade gradient) or ensure the last visible pill is not partially cut to signal scrollability more clearly.

issues.description: The pizza promotional image at the bottom of the screen is abruptly cut off with no visible text or discount details fully shown.
issues.suggestion: Ensure content sections have consistent spacing so cards are not awkwardly cropped by the viewport before scrolling.

issues.description: Inconsistent heart/favorite icon styling - white heart icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has no visible background contrast circle while the pizza card's heart icon has a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon treatment (background shape and color) across all promotional cards for visual consistency.
